title: India Post Releases Commemorative Postage Stamp Honouring Pioneer of Biogas Technology Shri Ram Bux Singh
subtitle: Philatelic tribute recognises his pioneering contributions to renewable energy, biogas technology and sustainable rural development
body_text:
The Department of Posts released a Commemorative Postage Stamp on 13 November 2026 , honouring Shri Ram Bux Singh (1925-2016) , a pioneering Indian scientist and internationally recognised expert in biogas technology and renewable energy. The stamp was jointly released by Shri Ramdas Athawale, Minister of State for Social Justice and Empowerment , and Col. Akhilesh Kumar Pandey, Chief Postmaster General, Delhi Circle , along with other senior dignitaries, at the Minister's residence in New Delhi. Hon’ble Minister of State for Social Justice and Empowerment Shri Ramdas Athawale, Col. Akhilesh Kumar Pandey, CPMG, Delhi Circle, and other dignitaries releasing the commemorative postage stamp honouring Shri Ram Bux Singh. Shri Ram Bux Singh made pioneering contributions to the development and promotion of biogas technology, particularly as a sustainable energy solution for rural communities. In 1957, he inaugurated one of India's earliest successful gobar gas plants at Sitapur, Uttar Pradesh. He later served for 16 years as Officer-in-Charge of Asia's first Gobar Gas Research Station at Ajitmal, Uttar Pradesh, and contributed to renewable energy initiatives in more than 15 countries. ( Commemorative Postage Stamp released in honour of Shri Ram Bux Singh (1925–2016), recognising his pioneering contributions to biogas technology and renewable energy.) His work also received international recognition, including references in the 1975 United States Senate Report and publications such as Mother Earth News . An accomplished author, he wrote several books on biogas technology, including Biogas Plant: Generating Methane from Organic Wastes , catalogued by the Library of Congress, United States. His research papers and professional records were acquired by the National Archives of India in September 2023 and digitised through the Abhilekh Patal portal. His contributions have also been recognised in NCERT textbooks. Through this Commemorative Postage Stamp, the Department of Posts pays tribute to Shri Ram Bux Singh's enduring legacy and his contributions to scientific research, renewable energy and sustainable rural development. The stamp celebrates his vision of harnessing locally available resources for clean energy and rural progress. Honouring a pioneer who harnessed the power of science for sustainable rural development!

The Department of Posts released a Commemorative Postage Stamp honouring Dr. Ram Bux Singh (1925–2016), a pioneering scientist and internationally recognised expert in biogas technology and renewable energy.

The stamp was released by Shri @RamdasAthawale , Hon’ble Minister of State for Social Justice & Empowerment, in the presence of Col. Akhilesh Kumar Pandey, Chief Postmaster General, Delhi Circle.

From inaugurating one of India’s earliest successful gobar gas plants in 1957 to advancing biogas initiatives across 15+ countries, Dr. Singh’s contributions continue to inspire the journey towards clean energy and rural progress.

A philatelic tribute to a visionary whose legacy continues to fuel a sustainable future.
